accessibilityEvidence.wcagCompliance: WCAG 2.1 AA (SC 1.4.1 Non-color-only, SC 1.4.3 Contrast Minimum >= 4.5:1, SC 2.1.1 Keyboard Navigation)
accessibilityEvidence.dualCoding: Every status indicator pairs color with unique icon (✓, ⏳, ⚠, ✕), text label, and full screen-reader ariaText
accessibilityEvidence.keyboardNavigation: Simulated modal focus trap and roving tabindex validated for dense grids and modals
accessibilityEvidence.ariaLiveRegions: Polite and assertive live-region emitters for real-time state and anomaly notifications

viewportTiers.mobile: 320px–767px (1 column, pinned left primary identifier column, horizontal scroll, badge lineage hash)

responsiveEvidence.zeroSilentClipping: Lineage hashes and financial figures use copyable/inspectable badges or full code blocks without lossy truncation

themeTokenEvidence.semanticTableStyles: Scoped row/col headers (th[scope="col"], th[scope="row"]) with institutional border and padding classes
